recommendation.name: CALL_LOCAL_BOUNDED_IMMUTABLE_CANONICAL_FRAGMENTS
phases: 1. Validate the entire fresh wire and capture immutable typed nodes exactly as current independent inverse, including every node/ordered edge/key/scalar/duplicate and whole root reachability. Do not consume encoder summaries/certificates/cached tables as authority.

2. Independently derive per-node canonical expanded byte length, ordinary occurrence count and maximum node-depth by child-before-parent dynamic programming. Scalar/key canonical bytes use the independent JSON semantics. Arrays add brackets+ordered children+commas; objects add braces+ordered exact key JSON+colons+children+commas. Stop before expansion if any reachable summary exceeds existing expanded-byte/depth bound. Multiplicity counts every repeated reference; keys count as syntax bytes, not ordinary value occurrences.

3. Optionally derive root occurrence multiplicities by reverse node order with full ordered-ref multiplicity. Deterministic proposed eligibility: repeated node with complete canonical size<=4096 B. Build a local bytes fragment only from freshly validated literals and independently justified child encodings; never identify by digest alone. Suggested separate cache ceilings:8MiB payload and65536 entries. These are proposed bounded optional cache ceilings, not raised qualification caps.

4. Cache eligibility/capacity is an optimization only. If a fragment would exceed either cache ceiling, omit that cache entry and use the ordinary iterative traversal. Do not reject, drop data, declare negative, or select a different input. Cache construction, summaries, attempted caching and fallback all consume the same newly declared20m actual-operation allowance and outer clock/memory.

5. At an encountered cached node, emit its complete immutable bytes on every occurrence instead of descending/tokenizing that subtree again. Split copying into at most64KiB blocks, include every copied byte in actual expanded-output accounting, and retain actual bytewise comparison with the complete ordinary original plus separately declared newline/hash. Uncached nodes retain ordinary traversal. No output byte, array/port multiplicity, object key or scalar disappears.

6. Keep complete end-of-stream size/occurrence reconciliation and final callback. A partial iterator, cache or saved wire remains unqualified. Release call-local cache when the generator ends/aborts; no cross-input, cross-call, historical or partially validated cache authority.
